_about: Frozen extraction units (prereg v3 4.3, 4.4). Section units are cut from `pdftotext -raw`, table units from `pdftotext -layout`. Only the main guideline body is used (KDIGO PDF pages >= 90); the front-matter summary of recommendations repeats the same statements and is not a listed section. Page numbers are PDF page indices; KDIGO journal page = PDF page + 115.

section_units.label: 3.1 CKD treatment and risk modification (with Figure 17)
3.15 Cardiovascular disease (CVD) and additional specific interventions to modify risk
5.2 Symptoms in CKD (prose; Tables 37 and 38 also given as table units)

table_units.label: Table 37 Recommended patient-reported outcome measurement tools for use in people with CKD
Table 38 Management strategies for common symptoms in CKD

recall_gate._about: Prereg 4.4 recall gate: the frozen prompt on P7's x5 sources, whole document as one unit (no section list exists for them), diabetes (BRFSS) domain.

chunking.tokenizer: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct GGUF vocabulary via llama.cpp b12283 /tokenize
chunking.boundary: line-snapped: a chunk ends at the last line break within 6,000 tokens; the next chunk starts at the last line break at or before (end - 500 tokens), so each overlap is at least 500 tokens
